run_qa_finetune: run the script to fine-tune a Hugging Face transformer model for question answering on a dataset
run_qa_train_eval: run the script with --do_train and --do_eval to fine-tune and evaluate a question answering model
run_qa_predict: run the script with --do_predict to generate question answering predictions on a test dataset
run_qa_custom_dataset: run the script with --train_file and --validation_file to fine-tune a model on a custom CSV or JSON dataset
run_qa_resume: run the script with --resume_from_checkpoint to resume fine-tuning a question answering model from a previous checkpoint
